title: 凌晨四点上班的面包师
title_en: Meet the Baker Who Starts at Four
summary_zh: Tom 是面包师，每天凌晨四点开工。他说起床难不难、一天先做什么、这份工作最好和最不好的地方，还有给想当面包师的人的建议。读完你能用 be used to、What's the best part… 聊聊一份工作。
body: Interviewer: Tom, you're a baker. What time do you start work? Tom: At four in the morning, five days a week. Interviewer: That's early! Is it hard to get up? Tom: It was hard at first, but now I'm used to it. I go to bed at nine. Interviewer: What do you do first? Tom: I turn on the ovens and make the bread dough. By six, the first loaves are ready. Interviewer: What's the best part of your job? Tom: The smell of fresh bread, and the quiet streets in the morning. Interviewer: And the worst part? Tom: I miss evenings with my friends. Interviewer: What would you tell someone who wants to be a baker? Tom: Learn to love the morning, and be patient. Good bread takes time.

questions.prompt: What is the interview mainly about?
options: Tom's working day as a baker and what he thinks of the job
questions.evidence: Tom, you're a baker. What time do you start work?

questions.prompt: Why does Tom go to bed at nine?
options: He has to get up very early for work
His friends go to bed early
questions.evidence: At four in the morning, five days a week.

questions.prompt: What is "dough" in "make the bread dough"?
options: a mix of flour and water before it is baked
questions.evidence: I turn on the ovens and make the bread dough.
I miss evenings with my friends.

vocabulary.example: The baker opens his shop at seven.
The ovens in the kitchen are very hot.
Leave the dough in a warm place for an hour.
She bought two loaves of bread.
Be patient — the bus will come soon.

expressions.note: At first I didn't like it, but now I do.
be used to sth / doing sth 表示“习惯于”。
Can you turn on the light?
The best part of the trip was the food.

knowledge.quote: I turn on the ovens and make the bread dough.
knowledge.explanation: 一般现在时说每天都做的事，介绍工作流程时最常用。

knowledge.quote: It was hard at first, but now I'm used to it.
knowledge.explanation: was 说过去的情况，now I'm 说现在：一句话里对比“以前难、现在习惯了”。

knowledge.quote: What would you tell someone who wants to be a baker?
knowledge.explanation: want to + 动词原形：wants to be 表示“想成为”。who 引导定语从句修饰 someone。

speaking: 两人一组：一人当记者，一人介绍自己（或家人）的工作。至少问一句 What's the best part of your job? 回答时用上 at first 和 be used to。
writing: 用 50–70 词介绍一个你认识的人的工作：几点上班、每天做什么、最喜欢和最不喜欢的地方。至少用一个 It was… at first, but now… 句子。

task.prompt: 仿照这句，用 It was … at first, but now I'm used to it 写一句话，说一件你慢慢习惯的事。
task.model: It was hard at first, but now I'm used to it.
